desc: Read the input values $N$, $p$, and the matrix $A$.
Count the total number of zeros $K$ in matrix $A$.
Construct matrix $M$ where $M_{ij} = A_{ij}$ if $A_{ij} \neq 0$ else $0$.
Identify the set $S$ of zero positions in $A$.
Implement the logic to calculate the contribution of "Type B" paths (paths with exactly one zero entry appearing $p-1$ times and one non-zero entry appearing once).
Apply the scalar factor $(-1)^{|S|} \pmod p$ to the sum of Type A and Type B contributions.
Print the resulting matrix row by row.
Run the code against Sample 1, 2, and 3 to verify correctness.
If Sample 1 passes, consider edge cases like $N=1$, $p=2$, $p=3$, $A$ all zeros, $A$ no zeros.
